solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Vault, source of water

definitions.meaning: to vault is to leap or ... over something
where water rises naturally from the ground

explanation.surface: A cellar vault that doubles as a well.
explanation.definitionFit: Spring is both a verb for leaping like a vaulter and a noun for a natural water source.

clue.text: Plate smashed, bit of a bloomer

indicators.note: a plate smashed is broken into pieces, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A broken plate, perhaps decorated with a flower, has shattered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' suggests a blunder (or an embarrassing mistake), but here it is a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A petal is one part of a flower's corolla, so a piece of a plant in bloom.

clue.text: Strong set with nine changes

indicators.note: the letters of the two words undergo changes, i.e. are rearranged

explanation.surface: A powerful team of nine players after a reshuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense feelings or flavours are strong ones; the two words are close synonyms.

clue.text: Not entirely splendid, slimy stuff

indicators.note: the synonym is given not entirely, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: good can mean splendid or excellent

explanation.surface: Something not quite wonderful turns out to be sticky muck.
explanation.definitionFit: Goo is informal for any sticky, viscous substance such as slime.

clue.text: Piece of Hollywood, epic theatrical show

indicators.note: Piece of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a grand Hollywood epic staged as a theatre production.
explanation.definitionFit: To depict something is to portray or represent it, i.e. to show it in pictures or words.

clue.text: Cleaner put off, man!

parts.note: to deter is to put off or discourage
gent is short for gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims in disgust at a cleaner who has been put off the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Detergent is a washing substance, a cleaning agent used for dishes or laundry.

clue.text: Petition putting pressure on chief

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on another sits above it, so it comes first

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for pressure in physics
lead, as an adjective, means chief or principal

explanation.surface: A petition that piles pressure on the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: To petition someone is to appeal or beg earnestly, which is what pleading means.

clue.text: Present flow of electricity

definitions.meaning: an electric ... is the flow of charge through a conductor

explanation.surface: An electrical flow happening right now.
explanation.definitionFit: Current is an adjective for contemporary or now-existing and a noun for moving charge in a wire.

clue.text: Modern gallery shrouded in gentle compassion

indicators.note: one piece is shrouded in the other, wrapped around by it

parts.note: soft means gentle or mild
the Tate is a group of famous art galleries in Britain
heart can mean compassion or kindness

explanation.surface: A contemporary art gallery wrapped in kindness and warmth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shrouded in' puts the gallery inside the word for gentle; the Tate is a family of national art galleries in Britain, including Tate Modern in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Something state of the art uses the latest techniques, so it is up to date and modern.

clue.text: Map pinpointing Libya and Nigeria, primarily

indicators.note: primarily here means taking each word's first, or primary, letter

explanation.surface: A map locating two North and West African countries.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan can be a drawing or diagram of an area, such as a street plan, much like a map.

clue.text: Shortened spanner held in hand, removing odd parts

indicators.note: one piece is held in the other, so it sits inside it
dropping the first and third letters of hand leaves only the even-placed ones

parts.note: a bridge spans a gap, so it is a spanner

explanation.surface: A cut-down wrench gripped in someone's hand, with bits removed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spanner' reads as a wrench (the British name for that tool), but it means something that spans a gap; 'held in' and 'removing odd parts' are the two indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: An abridged book or text has been condensed or cut down, i.e. made shorter.

clue.text: Woman writing a novel thus, Rose

indicators.note: novel as an adjective means new, so the letters take a new order

explanation.surface: A woman named Rose writes a novel in this way.
explanation.definitionFit: Authoress is the dated female form of author, a woman who writes books.

clue.text: A trail way up mountain

parts.note: a scent is the trail left by an animal for hounds to follow

explanation.surface: A footpath leading up a mountainside.
explanation.definitionFit: An ascent is a climb, the route by which a climber goes upward on a peak.

clue.text: Most important way to welcome foreigner

indicators.note: to welcome someone is to take them in, so one piece takes in the other

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
an alien is a foreigner, someone from another country

explanation.surface: The key way to greet an overseas visitor.
explanation.definitionFit: Salient points are the most noticeable or prominent ones, those that matter most.

clue.text: Figure important, though not the first

indicators.note: the synonym loses its first letter

parts.note: weighty means important or serious

explanation.surface: A significant number, though not the top one.
explanation.definitionFit: Eighty is a number, and figure means a numeral or number.

clue.text: Go on holiday? You must be joking!

definitions.meaning: to escape for a break or vacation

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at the suggestion of taking a vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means escape on a trip, and as an exclamation it expresses incredulity like 'no way!'

clue.text: Loss of power, shortage in fight

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other, placed inside it

parts.note: a bout is a boxing or wrestling contest, a fight
lack means a shortage or want

explanation.surface: A power cut caused by scarcity during a struggle.
explanation.definitionFit: A blackout is a failure of the electricity supply, leaving an area without power.

clue.text: Lovely thing diminished, that is

parts.note: cut means reduced or diminished
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A pretty object that has been made smaller.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutie is an attractive or endearing person or thing, informally a lovely one.

clue.text: Lob some balls, so thrown back

indicators.note: back says the hidden letters are read in reverse order
some of the words, a stretch of their letters, is taken

explanation.surface: Throw a few balls, thus pitched backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: The run SSOT sits across 'balls, so thrown'; 'back' turns it round. 'Thrown' tempts as an anagram signal but is just part of the hidden run.
explanation.definitionFit: To lob is to throw something in a high arc, to toss it.

clue.text: Father has name for seductress

parts.note: to sire is to father; a sire is a male parent

explanation.surface: A father with a reputation for a temptress.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Sirens lured sailors to their deaths, so a siren is an alluring, dangerous woman.

clue.text: Recent draw surprisingly inspiring pro footballer

indicators.note: inspiring literally means breathing in, so one piece takes in the other
the letters fall out surprisingly, in an unexpected order

parts.note: pro means for, as in the pros and cons

explanation.surface: A recent tied match surprisingly motivates a professional player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprisingly' rearranges RECENT DRAW into CENTREWARD, which takes in FOR. 'Pro' looks like it qualifies the footballer but supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A centre forward is the striker who plays in the central attacking position in soccer.

clue.text: Unfashionable openers in our university team

indicators.note: the opening letters of each of these words are taken

explanation.surface: The opening batsmen in our college side are dated.
explanation.definitionFit: When a style is out it is no longer in fashion, the opposite of in.

clue.text: Highlight small curl of hair

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a tress is a lock or curl of hair

explanation.surface: A hairdresser's instruction to colour one little ringlet.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress a point is to emphasise it, which is what highlighting it means.

clue.text: Hard, but having a go

definitions.meaning: difficult or wearing, hard to bear
attempting, having a go at something

explanation.surface: Something difficult, but at least an attempt is being made.
explanation.definitionFit: Trying as an adjective means exasperating or difficult; as a participle it means attempting.
